newsitem.title: GERMANY: Daimler's MTU to return to profit in '96.
newsitem.headline: Daimler's MTU to return to profit in '96.

text.p: Daimler-Benz AG's aero engine unit MTU Muenchen will return to the black this year with a profit of over 10 million marks ($6.6 million) after losing 368 million marks last year, chairman Rainer Hertrich said on Wednesday.
Hertrich also said MTU would achieve a target set by Daimler group management of a 12 percent return on capital by 1998 -- equivalent to a profit of 100 million marks.
Turnover should rise from 1.7 billion marks in 1995 to 2.5 billion marks next year. The MTU work force will be cut to between 5,500 and 5,600 by the end of 1997 from 6,700 at the end of last year.
